name: Uzziel
overview: The name Uzziel appears multiple times in Scripture, identifying distinct individuals across tribes and roles. He is noted as a son of Kohath and a Levite, with his descendants serving in priestly duties, as seen in Exodus where his sons Mishael and Elzaphan assist in sacred tasks. Another Uzziel is a Simeonite captain leading warriors, demonstrating leadership within Israel's tribal organization. Additionally, Uzziel is associated with the musical ministry of David, being a Levite descended from Jeduthun, and also recognized as a skilled goldsmith who contributed to the repair of Jerusalem's walls, highlighting the diverse service of those bearing this name in God's work.
